notes: Four isnads for one saying: the first three close with «كلهم عن الأعمش», the fourth with «قالا حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش»; the names from الأعمش on are written once and form the shared tail.
«أبو سعيد، الأشج» is one man written with a comma (rule 7).
The last link is عبد الله, the speaker of the saying inside the scene («فقال عبد الله») (rule 6); the man who came to him is a scene figure.
«- واللفظ ليحيى -» is an editor gloss and is left out.
